skillResults.name: review
skillResults.evidence: (1) Executed via SKILL.md fallback from /Users/Hugh/.claude/skills/gstack/review/SKILL.md plus independent subagent 019f3079-8267-79d1-b575-053baf7cf241; (2) checked scope drift, boundary conflicts, stale docs, structural risks, git status, forbidden runtime artifacts, and tracked/untracked package state; (3) found blocking scope and verification issues in sync parser commands, task-id normalization coverage, commit FR coverage, forbidden-file gate shape, and T007 dependency order; no tracked forbidden runtime artifact was found.

findings.issue: T001/T002 gate_cmd commands call .then(...) on require('./core/task-dir-parser.mjs'), but the current module returns a synchronous namespace object and parseTaskDir is synchronous. T002 also references normalizeTaskTrackingRoot without a corresponding implementation task or explicit export contract.
findings.impact: The gates fail or pass for command-shape reasons unrelated to FR-WORKTREE-ENVVAR-003. Executing as written can block a correct implementation or force an unplanned async/API change.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite parser gates to use the real API shape, for example node --input-type=module import { parseTaskDir } ... or require(...).parseTaskDir(...). If normalizeTaskTrackingRoot is required, add it explicitly to T001/spec/data-contracts as an exported helper; otherwise move normalization assertions into parser tests.
findings.requiredFix: Make all parser gate_cmd entries executable against the planned API and remove undefined helper assumptions.

findings.code: yaml 值以 `/tasks` 或 `/tasks/` 结尾时，parser 自动裁掉该后缀
findings.issue: Parser normalization semantics are inconsistent across artifacts. spec.md says yaml values ending in /tasks require migration or env override; tasks.md requires automatic trimming; data-contracts.md only says parser returns task_tracking_root and does not define trimming behavior.
findings.impact: Implementers can either produce /tasks/tasks/{task-id} or add an undocumented normalizer. The current repo config already uses a task_dir ending in /tasks, so the ambiguity affects the main fallback path.
findings.recommendation: Choose one canonical rule and state it in spec.md, plan.md, data-contracts.md, and T001/T002. Recommended: yaml fallback trims exactly one trailing /tasks or /tasks/ to task_tracking_root; WORKFLOWHUB_TASK_DIR must already be task_tracking_root; both paths are tested.
findings.requiredFix: Align normalization rule and gates across all artifacts.

findings.code: 改造 `core/task-dir-parser.mjs`：新增 `WORKFLOWHUB_TASK_DIR` env var 优先级
findings.issue: The parser behavior change lacks a real test task. Existing core tests still cover the old hardcoded ~/Knowledge/workflowhub fallback, while tasks.md relies on ad hoc node commands.
findings.impact: A core data-flow change can pass planning review without updating regression tests, or the implementation can break existing tests while gates only exercise shell snippets.
findings.recommendation: Add a T001 test-first subtask to update core/__tests__/task-dir-parser.test.mjs and run npx vitest run core/__tests__/task-dir-parser.test.mjs. Cover env priority, empty env, yaml fallback, missing yaml, missing task_dir, relative path, ~ path, nonexistent path, non-directory, and trailing /tasks normalization.
findings.requiredFix: Add runnable Vitest coverage before parser implementation gates.

findings.code: 缺失项列为 follow-up（本任务不修改上述 SKILL.md）
findings.issue: FR-WORKTREE-COMMIT-004 is a hard requirement for every stage/phase, but T008 only performs a read-only advisory audit and allows missing commit/no-change coverage to become follow-up. plan.md Verification Mapping also omits T008.
findings.impact: The package can pass while per-phase build-code commits and cross-stage no-change records remain unimplemented, leaving the cross-stage traceability problem unresolved.
findings.recommendation: Either narrow FR-WORKTREE-COMMIT-004 out of this task with explicit spec/design approval, or add implementation tasks and blocking gates for every affected row in the commit coverage matrix. Missing coverage must not be follow-up when the FR remains in scope.
findings.requiredFix: Make FR-WORKTREE-COMMIT-004 fully implemented and verified, or explicitly remove it from current scope.

findings.code: build-spec/SKILL.md 和 build-plan/SKILL.md 均仅只读核查，禁止任何修改
findings.issue: spec.md requires build-spec/build-plan to read worktree.json, use target_repo_root/worktree_root, and fail-loud when missing, but plan/tasks forbid modifying build-spec/build-plan and make missing fail-loud wording only a recorded conclusion.
findings.impact: FR-WORKTREE-SCOPE-008 cannot be satisfied if those skills lack the required behavior. Executors cannot both obey the forbidden-file boundary and implement the spec requirement.
findings.recommendation: Choose one: allow tightly scoped edits to workflows/build-spec/SKILL.md and workflows/build-plan/SKILL.md with exact gates, or downgrade FR-WORKTREE-SCOPE-008 to read-only audit only and remove MUST/fail-loud consumer obligations from spec/data-contracts.
findings.requiredFix: Resolve the forbidden-file vs required-behavior conflict before implementation.

findings.code: Consumer side | `build-code` §17 FR-WORKTREE-001、`verify-code` close 阶段
findings.issue: Contract 1 omits build-spec and build-plan as worktree.json consumers, while spec.md requires them to consume target_repo_root/worktree_root for path routing.
findings.impact: Implementation can miss two required consumers and still appear contract-compliant, breaking FR-WORKTREE-SCOPE-008 coverage.
findings.recommendation: Add build-spec and build-plan as read-only consumers in data-contracts.md, or revise spec.md to remove their consumer obligation.
findings.requiredFix: Align Contract 1 consumer list with spec.md SCOPE-008.

findings.code: 3rd-review 独立审查（merge 前，evidence/ 落盘，verdict=pass 继续）
findings.issue: The plan requires 3rd-review verdict=pass before irreversible actions, but current verify-code has an unavailable/not_executed review path that can proceed to merge. T004 does not explicitly remove or block that path.
findings.impact: If 3rd-review is missing or not executed, close can still merge/push/delete, defeating the main pre-merge safety goal.
findings.recommendation: T004 must explicitly require review unavailable/not_executed to block close and escalate_to_human, or provide an approved exception. Add a gate that rejects not_executed/proceed-to-merge semantics in verify-code/SKILL.md.
findings.requiredFix: Close path must require executed 3rd-review pass before irreversible actions, or the spec must be changed.

findings.issue: T006 requires stage-result.json and evidence/ to already exist under task_tracking_root, but these are verify-code close outputs. T004 only edits verify-code/SKILL.md; it does not run close.
findings.impact: Stage 3 can fail before the producer runs, or push agents to fabricate runtime artifacts just to satisfy the plan gate.
findings.recommendation: Change T006 to verify verify-code/SKILL.md path rules and repo absence only. Defer actual external artifact existence checks to verify-code close acceptance after close executes.
findings.requiredFix: Do not require runtime close artifacts before the close stage has produced them.

findings.code: ! git show HEAD -- specs/worktree-unification/ 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^\+\+\+ b/specs/.*(evidence/|stage-result\.json|journal\.jsonl|task-metrics\.jsonl)" | grep -q .
findings.issue: The forbidden-file gate checks git show diff headers instead of current repo state, and only stage-result.json has a direct test ! -f check. Top-level evidence/, journal.jsonl, or task-metrics.jsonl can exist untracked or pre-existing and still false-green.
findings.impact: FR-WORKTREE-SCOPE-009 can pass while forbidden runtime artifacts are present in specs/worktree-unification.
findings.recommendation: Replace with current-state checks: test ! -e specs/worktree-unification/evidence, test ! -f specs/worktree-unification/journal.jsonl, test ! -f specs/worktree-unification/task-metrics.jsonl, plus git ls-files and git ls-files --others --exclude-standard scans for forbidden paths.
findings.requiredFix: Make boundary gates inspect current tracked and untracked state, not only HEAD diff headers.

findings.issue: T007 says the acceptance checklist is for verify-code, but the dependency graph schedules it after T006, which validates verify-code close outputs. This places the checklist after the stage that needs to consume it.
findings.impact: verify-code cannot rely on the checklist during verification; acceptance evidence becomes post-hoc instead of executable input.
findings.recommendation: Move T007 before final verify-code/close boundary checks, or clarify it is post-run documentation and remove the claim that verify-code consumes it.
findings.requiredFix: Fix T007 dependency order and intended consumer.

findings.code: 每个 stage/phase 完成时至少执行一次 `git add + git commit`（不 push）
findings.issue: Contract 4 says every stage/phase must run git add + git commit, while spec.md says commits occur only when files changed, forbids empty stage markers, and requires no-change records otherwise.
findings.impact: Following the contract can create empty or unwanted commits and violate FR-WORKTREE-COMMIT-004.
findings.recommendation: Align Contract 4 with spec.md: commit only when a stage/phase produces file changes; otherwise record no-change reason in stage-result/journal; do not use --allow-empty as a stage marker.
findings.requiredFix: Remove unconditional commit wording from data-contracts.md.

findings.issue: Several gates are broad text greps/counts that can pass or fail on unrelated prose. Example: whole-file worktree add grep can false-fail on prohibition text; circled-number counts can pass outside close section; grep for stage-result.json proves only the string exists, not the write path.
findings.impact: F9 false-green/false-red risk remains. The plan can claim behavior is verified while only checking prose anchors.
findings.recommendation: Scope text checks to exact sections and ordered anchors, and add executable checks where behavior is required. At minimum, replace broad whole-file greps with section-bounded assertions and classify purely advisory text scans as non-gates.
findings.requiredFix: Replace fake-green-prone gates with objective section-bounded or executable checks.

findings.code: 本轮发现 9 条问题（5 blocking + 4 important），全部已修复。
findings.issue: Closure documents claim all round-9 issues are fixed, but this review found current blocking issues. Related stale files include constitution-check.md and plan-eng-review.md with outdated checklist/review state.
findings.impact: Review package gives contradictory pass/fail signals and makes it hard to identify authoritative evidence.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the closure matrix and constitution check from the current checklist, or mark stale review outputs superseded and keep only dated historical reports outside the current review package.

findings.issue: Runtime run-manifest.json files are not ignored or clearly classified, while untracked run manifests under specs/worktree-unification/tasks contain in_progress state. specs tasks/reviews paths are otherwise allowed package paths.
findings.impact: Transient runtime state can be accidentally committed and confuse future review packages.
findings.recommendation: Either move run-manifest.json to task_tracking_root, add a specific ignore rule, or define which review manifests are commit-worthy and exclude transient in_progress manifests.

resolutionSummary: Round 1 full review of wu-r9-input.md: prior B3/B4/B5/B9/B10/B11/B12/B13 fixes are partly closed, but current plan/tasks remain non-executable because parser gates use the wrong API shape, normalization semantics are split, parser tests are missing, commit coverage is advisory despite a hard FR, build-spec/build-plan scope conflicts with SCOPE-008, close review gating is not fail-closed, runtime artifact gates are ordered incorrectly, and several gates can fake green. Verdict: revise_required.

findings.description: Spec describes a schema/contract/gate (cluster A) with soft-fail, optional, or warning-only validation — or a check that bypasses its own control switch (cluster B: soft-fail/swallow/bypass-flag terms). A gate that does not hard-block on failure allows output drift — schema-drift blocking.

Spec describes or requires eliminating internal contradictions between field contracts or rule statements (cluster A: schema/contract terms + cluster B: conflict/contradiction/duplicate terms). Multiple conflicting schemas for the same entity cause silent drift — schema-drift blocking.

Spec describes timing-trigger metadata duplicated or flattened across multiple authoritative sources (cluster: trigger-timing terms + conflict/flatten/multiple-source terms). Divergent timing records cause gate behavior drift — schema-drift important.
